summary: Banco BBVA Argentina filed a Form 6-K furnishing its financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, under Argentine regulatory requirements (Article 63 of BYMA rules). The filing discloses that the controlling group holds 407,785,801 common shares, representing 66.55% of total capital stock, with parent Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria S.A. as controlling shareholder. No transaction, event, or strategic action is announced; this is a routine periodic reporting disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
